name: Chronocooked
description: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models.
